correctness.rationale: The proof reduces every solution to a dyadic partial sum \(S\) and a \(p\)-divisible remainder. Binary carrying gives \(1-S\ge 2^{-r}\); the \(p\)-divisible terms give \(1-S\le (R-r)/p\); exact integer optimization yields \(R\ge\lfloor\log_2p\rfloor+2\). All endpoint cases are covered, and the Fermat equality identity is exact.
